items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Barney Begard does it, and yet I've known other clarinetists that would bite onto the mouthpiece.

ctx.x: Well that's one thing I could take Waltz as a one for, he liked me. He taught me that.

And you still use that, you always did use that, at the very beginning. Barney Begard does it, and yet I've known other clarinetists that would bite onto the mouthpiece. I think George Lewis does that another day too. Yeah. Hello, come in, that's alright. We were just having a visit, talking here on the microphone here.
Well, just for curiosity, I tried that, because I knew the fellas was doing that, and I just tried that to see how it feels. I just couldn't stand it. No. The vibration.
